section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the superiority of the self-nullification of this day over that of the desert lies in two aspects, particularly that it extends into the reality of the person, completing the purpose of a dwelling place in the lower realms.
section.t: And 4)
And likewise is it regarding the two matters of Rosh Chodesh Sivan,
the self-nullification of this day and the self-nullification of the desert57,
that the superiority of the self-nullification of this day over the self-nullification of the desert is in two matters.
That the self-nullification of this day
(where the love is in a state of self-nullification)
is also within the reality of the person.
And that specifically through this the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section states that the self-nullification of this day extending into the person's reality comes through the drawing down of Atzmus (Awtsmoos), which has the power to unite two opposites.
section.t: And one may add,
that this—that the self-nullification of this day is drawn also into the reality of the person
[and even after the self-nullification that is drawn into his reality, it is
(not a nullification of existence,
but rather)
a nullification within existence],
is through the drawing down of Atzmus (Awtsmoos),
for in the power of Atzmus (Awtsmoos) is to unite two opposites
(self-nullification and existence).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the term "this day" alludes to the revelation of the power of Atzmus (Awtsmoos), as the true meaning of "this" applies only to Atzmus (Awtsmoos) itself.
section.t: And it can be said that this is also hinted at in the language of the verse "on this day."
For it is explained in Likkutei Torah58,
that the term "this,"
which is a thing that one can point to with a finger and say "this,"
applies only to the Holy One, blessed be He,
as it is written59
"This is my G-d and I will glorify Him,"
for "the whole earth is full of His glory"60.
And it is explained elsewhere61
that the true concept of "this" applies only to Atzmus (Awtsmoos).
For the meaning of "this" is that the thing about which one says "this"
is the very existence of that thing,
and since all existing things,
including even the most sublime revelations,
their existence is not from themselves but is dependent upon the will of Atzmus (Awtsmoos)62,
one cannot say of them in a complete sense "this thing,"
and the true concept of "this" applies only to Atzmus (Awtsmoos).
And this is "on this day,"
that even the existence of the diffusion
(day)
is in a state of self-nullification
(this),
is through the revelation of the power of Atzmus (Awtsmoos),
day
(revelation)
this.
